hub.speaker: Selys
hub.text: Guild's closed for lunch. Unless you're here about the thing Erin won't stop signing her letters about?

options.text: Erin's package. I'll spare you the small talk. (Lyonette's advice)

options._comment: stage-2 hub topic, lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/selys_stages.json. Appended AFTER 'Just looking around.' (array end) so it can never shift an earlier option's visible index.
options.text: Shivertail. Any relation to the Guildmistress?

options._comment: Selys' perk (selys_past_the_counter stage) -- REPEATABLE (issue #32 ruling, supersedes the shipped ONE-TIME v1): the stage-2 accomplishment leg still gates unlock, but the retire mechanic is now the once_per_waking seam (issue #23's {accomplishment, once_per_waking} sanctioned compound, same idiom as Erin's meal / Relc's wager) instead of a permanent claimed_board_pick hide_when -- sleep clears entity_first_use, so a fresh vetted-job pointer + 5g is available again every waking. bank_first_use lives on selys_board_pick's own closing option (effects on options, never nodes -- house shape), same pattern as Krshia's/Zevara's perks.
options.text: Anything on the board worth my time?

options._comment: desk-context line, lifted VERBATIM from docs/design/board-staging/board-copy.md sec.2 (the board is now a physical prop in the guild interior behind her desk). Ungated orientation flavor -- appended at array end so no earlier option's visible index shifts. The other 5 sec.2 lines (accept/road-cull-steer/turn-in-met/turn-in-unmet/slate-rotated) were DP2-conditioned in DP1; DP2 wires them below.

Opens the board's live accept picker (built at runtime from data/bounties.json's current active slate -- see bounties.gd; the picker itself is code, not a static node here, which is why this option's effect is a signal, not a goto into more authored content). Hidden once a posting is already accepted -- v1 simplification, one job at a time (disclosed in the DP2 report): Selys won't log a second slip while one's outstanding. Appended at array end so no earlier option's visible index shifts.

Resolves a turn-in attempt against whichever posting is currently accepted (WIGame.turn_in_bounty -- gold + a completed_bounty_<id> accomplishment on a MET condition, opaque-safe refusal line on an unmet one; no progress numbers either way). Hidden until a posting is accepted (the mirror gate of 'Take on a posting.' above).

The abandon path -- the one-shot soft-lock (bounty_sewer_survey/bounty_silk_line/bounty_vermin_grate keying on accomplishments a player can bank BEFORE accepting) needed both an absolute-mode condition fix (bounties.gd/data/bounties.json) AND an exit so accepted_bounty_id never gets permanently stuck for any future unfulfillable posting. Same requires gate as 'Turn in my posting.' above (visible only while a posting is outstanding) -- WIGame.abandon_bounty clears the slip with no pay, no penalty; Selys's line lives in the code-built result graph (WIBounties.build_abandon_graph), same home as her accept/turn-in reaction lines. Appended at array end so no earlier option's visible index shifts.

selys_board_context.speaker: Selys
selys_board_context.text: The board's behind you. Reading it is free. Taking a posting means telling me, so I can log it and not have to chase you across Liscor.

selys_gran.speaker: Selys
selys_gran.text: Grandmother. Yes, THE Tekshia Shivertail. Yes, she still throws a spear better than half the Silver-ranks. No, I will not introduce you when she's in a mood, which is always. I wanted to be her when I was small. Then I noticed the paperwork ran in the family and picked the desk with better hours.

options.text: You wanted to be a hero?

selys_gran_two.speaker: Selys
selys_gran_two.text: Everyone behind this counter did, once. Then you log your first casualty report. The desk keeps more people alive than a sword does. That took me years to believe, so you don't have to believe it today. Now stop making me sincere during business hours.

selys_board_pick.speaker: Selys
selys_board_pick.text: One job. I flagged it because the client isn't insane and the pay is honest: a courier run out to Riverfarm, nothing that bites back. Bring me the receipt and I'll square you from the Guild's own purse, not the client's excuse for one.

delivered.speaker: Selys
delivered.text: Finally. Here - she overpaid the courier fee, as always. Take it back or keep it, I honestly don't care which.

delivered_smooth.speaker: Selys
delivered_smooth.text: Hm. Someone's been talking to Lyonette. Fine - here's the fee Erin overpaid, and tell that barmaid she's wasted on pouring drinks.
